target_customer: Mining, infrastructure and land intelligence teams (as launched in 2025)
problem: Scanned maps, plats and survey drawings must be aligned to real coordinates by hand or by specialists, leaving spatial data locked in documents.

technical_complexity.rationale: Vision models for map alignment were available in 2025 but accuracy on messy historical plats needs custom pipelines.

defensibility.rationale: Relies on general vision models, so rivals can replicate; value may build with labelled map data but no source shows this.

market_need_then: YC page says teams hire specialists or skip georeferencing. No dated spend data found.
